_comment: A scheduled run CANCELLED BEFORE ANY JOB EXISTED — the real shape of run 33992051892 (created
⚠ THIS IS A THIRD ROUTE, NOT A REPEAT. `cancel-in-progress` is false for `schedule`, so it protects
a RUNNING run and never a PENDING one; a pending run superseded by the next hourly is cancelled
before it is ever expanded into jobs. So there is NO JOB OBJECT AT ALL — and therefore no
`runner_name` to interrogate, which is the discriminator every other case turns on.
Not-dispatched and no-such-job reach the same verdict (no claim, look beneath it) by different
paths, and only one of them has an object to ask. Flagged by the PO on exactly that reasoning.
